text:
🚀 Hiring: Pattern Agent Developer (Senior – Design Authority)
📍 Remote | 📝 9-Week Contract | 🕓 🕓 4:00 PM IST – 12:00/1:00 AM IST(4+ Hours Overlap with US Mountain Time)
We're looking for a Senior Pattern Agent Developer to design and build the intelligence layer of an AI runtime platform, enabling validated patterns to evolve into shared knowledge.
Key Responsibilities
Design pattern graduation algorithms with confidence scoring and probabilistic promotion logic.
Build a three-layer matching architecture (Direct Lookup → Similarity Search → LLM Fallback).
Develop anonymization pipelines and Zone 3 write-paths for shared intelligence.
Implement correction capture and human-in-the-loop approval workflows.
Collaborate with GraphRAG/Data Engineers and Agent Developers on knowledge graph design and AI orchestration.
Must-Have Skills
✅ Python
✅ ML Pipeline Design & Inference Pipelines
✅ Probabilistic Models & Confidence Scoring
✅ Knowledge Graphs & Graph Data Structures
✅ Vector Similarity Search (pgvector or equivalent)
✅ PII Anonymization & Data Privacy
✅ Approval Workflow Design / State Machines
📩 Interested candidates, please share your updated resume to srujanat@teizosoft.com with the subject "Pattern Agent Developer".

author: Klaudia Filip-Mirek, hiring
text:
🚀 We're hiring a Data Product Architect at Vonage - and this one is different.

This isn't a heads-down coding role. It's a seat at the table where data architecture decisions get made for a unified communications platform serving millions of users worldwide.

You'll work across hundreds of engineers, set the vision for scalable multi-tenant data products, and act as a trusted advisor to engineering and product teams. You'll have real influence at a company scaling fast in the comms space. 🌍

You'll thrive here if you: 
✅ Have 10+ years building software and data-heavy systems 
✅ Know how to influence without authority
✅ Have designed data products that actually scale 
✅ Love connecting technical decisions to real business outcomes

Modern stack includes AWS, Kafka, Snowflake, Spark, Looker & AI/ML. Telecom or SaaS experience? Even better. 🎯

📍 Remote-friendly within Poland

If you're the kind of architect who leaves things better than you found them - let's talk with me or Ilya Hardzeenka from technical team. 

What's the most complex data architecture challenge you've tackled? 👇
